PROJECT 3CAMERA SYSTEMS / GAME ARCHITECTURE

OutRun.

Observe. Decide. Move. A third-person puzzle prototype where surveillance-camera feeds become the player's view of the world.

Lead programmerUnreal Engine 5Multi-camera

LEAD PROGRAMMER

A camera-driven interaction loop

Independently designed the program architecture and implemented the control logic behind the surveillance mechanic. Players observe different angles of the same environment and use that information to direct a third-person character.

Rendering & game systems

Simplified the rendering pipeline and tuned frame-rate parameters for simultaneous camera views. Animation state machines connect attack, hit and death feedback to character state, while UI data binding provides real-time display.

Patrol & pursuit

The boss patrols between predefined waypoints, chases the player on sight and stops pursuing when visual contact is lost.
